subject: maths
question: Ajay can row his boat in still water, at a speed of 11 km/hr. If the speed of the stream is 7 km/hr, how long will it take to a distance of 54 km downstream?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of Ajay in still water = 11 km/hr,

Speed of stream = 7 km/hr,

Distance = 54 km

**Formula:**

Time = distance/speed,

Speed downstream = Speed in still water + Speed of stream

**Solution:**

⇒ Speed downstream = 11 + 7 = 18 km/hr

⇒ Time = 54/18 = 3 hours

**Therefore, it will take Ajay 3 hours to cover a distance of 54 km downstream.**
